Melayu: Ciri Baru - Rating Aplikasi: Suka aplikasi ini? Selepas beberapa lama menggunakan, anda akan digesa untuk memberi rating di App Store atau Google Play.
Butang 'Beri Rating' di Tetapan: Buka halaman rating secara manual dari menu Tetapan.
Gesaan Bijak: Aplikasi tidak mengganggu — gesaan hanya muncul selepas beberapa lagu dibuka, dengan jeda 60 hari, dan boleh dimatikan terus.
Pembaikan & Kestabilan: Beberapa pepijat kecil dibaiki.
Memperbaiki lirik lagu A17 (percobaan → pencobaan) dan R351 (Tuban → Tuhan).
English: New Feature - Rate the App: Enjoying the app? After using it for a while, you'll be invited to rate it on the App Store or Google Play.
'Rate This App' Button in Settings: Open the rating page manually from the Settings menu.
Smart Prompts: The app won't pester you — prompt only appears after several songs have been opened, with a 60-day cooldown, and can be dismissed permanently.
Fixes & Stability: Several minor bugs were fixed.
Fixed lyrics for A17 (percobaan → pencobaan) and R351 (Tuban → Tuhan).
